suppress.notes: CVE-2026-53914 affects Kotlin build-cache metadata processing. The matched kotlin-stdlib artifact does not contain or process the vulnerable build cache.
CVE-2026-39883 affects OpenTelemetry Go PATH handling on BSD and Solaris. Dependency-Check incorrectly matched it to the Java semantic conventions artifact.

GHSA-qwww-vcr4-c8h2 affects React Router's unstable React Server Components mode. This application uses server-side Vaadin Flow and has no Hilla or RSC routes. Review this suppression when Vaadin supports React Router 8.3.0 or another fixed release.
